findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "From ESG assessment to measurable progress." → 3 lines (6 words, 56px); "Understand what responsible business means today" → 3 lines (6 words, 56px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Turn insights into action" above "From ESG assessment to measurable progre"; "Clear insights.Smarter decisions." above "Your ESG journey, on one platform."; "Built for real business impact" above "Across industries. For a more responsibl"; "Contact" above "Every responsible journey starts somewhe"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 17 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "ESG intelligence platform", "Connected consequencesBetter decisions", "About RITVA", "Turn insights into action").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: figure.panel → rgb(215, 206, 190) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(32, 36, 42, 0.45) 0px 18px 40px -28px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 5 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.bar 1440px | div.panel-top 700px | nav.panel-rail 150px | figcaption#panelCap 700px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (1 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The sheet dealt EB Garamond and EB Garamond, but the page renders Inter, Cormorant Garamond.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: Only 7 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: The margins differ: 31px on the left, 61px on the right, at 768px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Across industries. For a more responsible tomorr" → 3 lines (7 words, 32px); "Understand what responsible business means today" → 3 lines (6 words, 32px); "Every responsible journey starts somewhere." → 3 lines (5 words, 32px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
